entries.def:
Βέροια, -ας, ἡ, 
Berœa, a city of Macedonia: Act.17.10, 13.†
(AS)

Βηθαβαρά, -ας (Rec. -ρᾶ, indecl.; Heb. בֵּית עֲבָרָה, place of crossing; -αραβᾷ, R, mg.), 
Bethabara: Jhn.1.28, Rec. (WH, R, βηθανία).†
(AS)

Βηθανία, -ας (also -ιά, indecl., Luk.19.29 and in B*, Mrk.11.1), ἡ, (Heb. בֵּית עֲנִיָּה, house of affliction, accusative to Jerome, or perh., house of dates, cf. Bethphage), 
Bethany; 
__1. a village fifteen furlongs from Jerusalem, the modern El Azerîyeh: Mat.21.17; 26.6, Mrk.8.22 (WH, mg.) 11:1, 11, 12 14:3 Luk.19.29; 24.50, Jhn.11.1, 18; 12.1. 
__2. A place on E. bank of Jordan: Jhn.1.28 (R, mg., Βηθαβαρά, which…

Βηθεσδά, ἡ, indecl. (deriv. uncertain, see Westc. on Jhn.5.2, and DB, i, 279), 
Bethesda, a pool in Jerusalem: Jhn.5.2, Rec. (Βηθζαθά, WH, Βηθσαϊδά, WH, mg.).†
(AS)

Βηθλέεμ, ἡ, indecl. (Heb. בֵּית לֶחֶם, house of bread), 
Bethlehem, a town 6 m. S. of Jerusalem: Mat.2.1, 5, 6, 8, 16, Luk.2.4, 15 Jhn.7.42.†
(AS)

Βηθσαιδά (Rec. -σαϊδά), and -δάν (Mt, Mk, ll. with), ἡ, indecl. (Syr., house of fish), 
Bethsaida, a town on NE. shore of the Sea of Galilee: Luk.9.10. It is generally supposed that a second B. on the W. shore is referred to in Mat.11.21, Mrk.6.45; 8.22, Luk.10.13, Jhn.1.45; 12.21 (DB, i, 282f.; but see Swete on Mrk.6.45). 
__2. 2. Βηθζαθά, ἡ, indecl. (perh. Aram. בֵּית זַיְתָה, house of olives) Jhn.5.2..†
(AS)

Βηθφαγή (L, -γῆ), ἡ, indecl. (Aram. בֵּית־פַּגֵּי, house of unripe figs; Dalman, Gr., 191), 
Bethphage: Mat.21.1, Mrk.11.1, Luk.19.29.†
(AS)

βῆμα, -τος, τό 
(βαίνω), [in LXX: Deu.2.5 (מִדְרָךְ), Neh.8.4 (מִגְדָּל), I Est.9.42, Sir.19.30; 45.9, 2Ma.13.26 * ;] 
__1. a step, stride, pace: Act.7.5. 
__2. a raised place, a platform reached by steps, originally that in the Pnyx at Athens from which orations were made; frequently of the tribune or tribunal of a Roman magistrate or ruler: Mat.27.19, Jhn.19.13, Act.12.21; 18.12, 16, 17; 25.6, 10, 17; β. τοῦ θεοῦ,…

βήρυλλος, -ου, ὁ, ἡ, 
[in LXX: Tob.13.17 (-ύλλιον in Exo.28.20, שֹׁהַם * ;]) 
beryl, a jewel of sea-green colour: Rev.21.20.†
(AS)
